description: § 469(i)(3)(E)(i): modified AGI is figured without § 86 benefits. Single retiree, $90,000 taxable pension, $40,000 Social Security, $20,000 actively managed rental loss. Without the passive loss, taxable benefits are $34,000 (85%), but modified AGI excludes them: $90,000, under $100,000, so all $20,000 is allowed. With the loss in AGI, provisional income is 70,000 + 20,000 = 90,000 → taxable benefits min(85% x 40,000, 85% x (90,000 − 34,000) + 4,500) = $34,000; AGI = 70,000 + 34,000 = $104,000.
